title: A Synthetic Overview of Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation combines information retrieval with text generation so answers can be grounded in external context. This synthetic demo record mentions question answering, recall, precision, and dense retrieval.

title: Synthetic GraphRAG for Multi-Hop Retrieval
abstract: GraphRAG uses graph retrieval to connect papers, methods, datasets, and metrics for multi-hop reasoning. This synthetic demo record mentions HotpotQA, faithfulness, and context precision.

title: Synthetic Agentic RAG Query Planning
abstract: Agentic RAG introduces query planning, retrieval routing, evidence verification, and citation checking. The method can choose hybrid search, graph retrieval, or reranking based on the question type.

title: Synthetic Hybrid Search for Reliable Retrieval
abstract: Hybrid search combines BM25 and vector search to improve retrieval quality. This synthetic record discusses information retrieval, Natural Questions, latency, and reranker interfaces.

title: Synthetic Evaluation Metrics for Grounded RAG
abstract: RAG evaluation can use citation accuracy, answer relevancy, context precision, and faithfulness as proxy metrics before adopting full RAGAS or DeepEval pipelines.
